verdict.rationale: Evidence only tangentially references availability settings — 'preset work hours' for round-robin links and 'budget your time using calendar events' to honor scheduling preferences — but there is no explicit documentation of a full availability-schedule builder with working hours, date overrides, or dedicated out-of-office periods. missing for 10: explicit docs on defining weekly working-hour schedules, date-specific overrides, and out-of-office blocking.
